This '''skirmish''' took place in the [[Feswe Corridor]], immediately following an [[Battle of Skorrupon (Galactic Civil War)|initial attack]] at [[Skorrupon/Legends|Skorrupon]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that failed to stop the advance of the newly-completed [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] as it neared the [[Great Temple/Legends|Rebel base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Alliance [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Vrad Dodonna]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] were assigned to use the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]]-negating effects of a [[power gem]] to disrupt the ''Executor''{{'s}} shields and inflict enough damage to stop the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer's]] approach. Dodonna, disillusioned with the Rebel Alliance after the first failed attack, instead hoped to sabotage the mission to bargain for his own life with the Empire. After ditching Skywalker on a nearby [[Planet/Legends|planetoid]], he eventually had a change of heart and rammed his [[Power-gem attack ship|craft]] into the ''Executor'', killing himself, but failing to knock out the ''Executor''{{'s}} shields, which had been switched to double-front. The shielding setting, however, left the ''Executor''{{'s}} aft section exposed, allowing [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and Skywalker in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] a clear shot that disabled the Super Star Destroyer's gyro-control system.

With the ''Executor'' temporarily delayed, the Rebellion gained enough time to safely evacuate their Yavin 4 base, but a large Imperial blockade still waited for them under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Amise Griff]].
